objective: Replay the frozen H67 ep35 S10 four-bottleneck Conv3x3 original 16-bit im2col masks through the unmodified official Prosperity CPU cycle path, comparing official product sparsity against the official bit-sparsity mode on the identical H67 matrices.

exact_batching_proof_obligation.method: Run the official CPU path at one complete 128-output N tile, then expand the six identical N tiles algebraically using the exact official run_fc equations.
exact_batching_proof_obligation.reason: For K=16 there is one K tile; the official implementation repeats the same activation preprocessing for each 128-output N tile. All counter fields scale by six. The final memory-stall equation is recomputed with the official one-time initial transfer and the six-tile total traffic.

reporting.primary_comparison: official Prosperity product-sparsity cycles versus official Prosperity bit-sparsity cycles on identical H67 original16 matrices

fail_closed: Abort on any frozen SHA, repository commit, repository cleanliness, line count, fixed-width row, population or operator-order mismatch.
Abort unless all direct N=768 checks exactly match the N=128 algebraic expansion for both official modes.
Do not divide these cycles by M430/M467 cycles: the resource and cycle-boundary contracts differ.
Do not call this a full-network, FPS, energy, PPA or system-speedup result.
